parsed.post: Discarding my last run (0.8823); it was a significant regression from my best 0.8538. It looks like my previous batch size reduction might have been a fluke or the learning rate was poorly tuned for that step. Reverting to my best and testing MATRIX_LR 0.08 as planned.
parsed.description: Testing MATRIX_LR 0.08 on the previous best configuration (DEPTH=6, BATCH=262144, WARMUP=0.05, SHARDS=0-10) to see if a slightly higher learning rate improves convergence at this batch size.
